bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: Quarterback Caleb Williams suffered a hamstring injury during the Bears' 9-3 loss to the Vikings in Week 2, but the Bears and their fans have no doubt been holding their breath ever since quarterback Caleb Williams suffered a non-contact hamstring injury during the Week 2 loss to the Minnesota Vikings, and it appears Williams has avoided a significant injury. If Williams cannot go, Tyson Bagent will take the reins of the offense as Chicago prepares to host the Philadelphia Eagles on Monday Night Football in Week 3.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are dealing with significant secondary injuries heading into Week 3, as safety Avonte Maddox will miss the rest of the 2026 season after undergoing surgery for a left foot injury sustained in the Week 2 loss to Buffalo, joining Brian Branch (Achilles) and Kerby Joseph (knee) on the sidelined list. With Chuck Clark and Thomas Harper now expected to serve as Detroit's starting safeties for the time being , the Lions also made roster moves this week, including signing safety Bishop Fitzgerald off the Steelers' practice squad ahead of their Week 3 matchup against the New York Jets.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers are gearing up for a Thursday Night Football matchup against the Atlanta Falcons at Lambeau Field, but they'll be shorthanded after releasing their final injury report which confirms they'll be without two starting offensive linemen for the game . Adding to the injury concerns, Packers' Zach Bako-Bewele tore his patellar tendon against the Jets , while the team also continues to monitor Jayden Reed after his Week 2 neck injury.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: Kyler Murray has cleared the NFL's concussion protocol and is set to start at quarterback for the 2-0 Vikings in Week 3 against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, reclaiming the job from Carson Wentz. Adding to Minnesota's backfield concerns, running back Aaron Jones was reported hurt and not practicing this week, with his availability against Tampa Bay now in question.
